## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-*juan* Northern-Sòng glossarial subcommentary on [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán's *Zhǐguān fǔxíng* ([KR6d0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0131), T1912) by [有嚴](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%89%E5%9A%B4) Yǒuyán (1021–1101) of Tāizhōu — the same scholar whose *Bèijiǎn* ([KR6d0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0009)) and *Jiānnán* ([KR6d0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0020)) provide the parallel third-order subcommentaries on the *Xuányì* / *Shìqiān* and *Wénjù* / *Wénjù jì* commentarial chains. Together with these two, the *Zhùlǎn* completes Yǒuyán's three-part Northern-Sòng glossarial apparatus on the entire Tiāntái triple-treatise commentarial chain.

**Abstract**

Yǒuyán's *Zhùlǎn* completes his three-part Northern-Sòng glossarial apparatus on the Tiāntái triple-treatise commentarial chain. Its method is parallel to the *Bèijiǎn* ([KR6d0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0009)) on the *Xuányì* / *Shìqiān*: glossarial annotation of obscure references, citations, and technical terms in Zhànrán's *Zhǐguān fǔxíng*, drawing on Sòng-period scholastic resources unavailable to Táng-period readers.

The composition is dated, with Yǒuyán's other glossarial works, to the late Yuánfēng 元豐 era (post-1078) through the early Jiànzhōngjìngguó 建中靖國 era (1101, the year of Yǒuyán's death).
